description: Get full financial statement metrics per fiscal period — all entity_financial_metrics columns. Includes cash_and_equivalents, inventories, receivables, liabilities, equity, cost breakdown, revenue lines. The standalone row of the latest analysed statement also has `notes` (additional information from the statement): average employment (employees_avg, employees_avg_prev), income tax, profit distribution and dividend, parent and ultimate parent, related-party transactions, shareholdings, guarantees and contingent liabilities, loans, auditor fee, revenue split. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).
